DiCaprio plays Danny Archer, a mercenary trafficker looking for a precious diamond amid the chaos of the Civil War in Sierra Leone and Honso (Gladiator) as a miserable father looking for his missing son and A Beautiful Mind as a journalist looking for the truth behind the trade in "conflict diamonds." Forced to face the brutal human cost of diamond trade, Archer changes his search for financial reward and seeks a search for salvation.

umc.cmc.5ud0ivpwgqw2st0u4z73gwpar.text: 在这部充满冷酷操纵和高风险权力游戏的纽约市新黑色惊悚片中，没有人是他们看起来的那样。
umc.cmc.5ud0ivpwgqw2st0u4z73gwpar.original: No one is who they seem in this neo-noir New York City thriller of ruthless manipulations and high-stakes power games.

umc.cmc.40gvwq6hnbilmnxuutvmejx4r.text: Cherry（Tom Holland 饰）从大学辍学生流落为伊拉克的陆军医疗兵——唯一的精神支柱是他唯一的真爱 Emily（Ciara Bravo 饰）。但在带着创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）从战争中归来后，随着他在世界上艰难寻找自己的位置，他的生活陷入了毒品和犯罪的漩涡。
umc.cmc.40gvwq6hnbilmnxuutvmejx4r.original: Cherry (Tom Holland) drifts from college dropout to army medic in Iraq—anchored only by his one true love, Emily (Ciara Bravo). But after returning from the war with PTSD, his life spirals into drugs and crime as he struggles to find his place in the world.

umc.cmc.4wfs3tno6kih50j21qgn1n0m3.text: 1945 年 4 月。随着盟军在欧洲战场发起最后冲刺，一位久经沙场的陆军中士 Wardaddy（Brad Pitt 饰）指挥着一辆谢尔曼坦克及其五人机组，在敌后执行一项致命任务。在敌众我寡、火力悬殊且排里塞进了一名菜鸟士兵的情况下，Wardaddy 和他的部下们在英勇袭击纳粹德国心脏的尝试中面临着压倒性的艰难险阻。
umc.cmc.4wfs3tno6kih50j21qgn1n0m3.original: April, 1945. As the Allies make their final push in the European Theatre, a battle-hardened army sergeant named Wardaddy (Brad Pitt) commands a Sherman tank and her five-man crew on a deadly mission behind enemy lines. Outnumbered and outgunned, and with a rookie soldier thrust into their platoon, Wardaddy and his men face overwhelming odds in their heroic attempts to strike at the heart of Nazi Germany.

umc.cmc.ljmzio5szpnhca4ydns8f99q.text: 美国顶尖大学里最聪明的头脑不是学生……而是擦地板的小伙。威尔·亨廷是一个固执的工人阶级天才，却在生活的课堂上屡屡不及格。在一次次触犯法律之后，威尔的最后希望是一位心理学教授，他或许是唯一能走入他内心的人。
umc.cmc.ljmzio5szpnhca4ydns8f99q.original: The most brilliant mind at America’s top university isn’t a student...he’s the kid who cleans the floors. Will Hunting is a headstrong, working-class genius who’s failing the lessons of life. After one too many run-ins with the law, Will’s last chance is a psychology professor who might be the only man who can reach him.

umc.cmc.3sr644gks0beiq8og6ax314ww.text: 奥斯卡奖得主罗宾·威廉姆斯、阿尔·帕西诺和希拉里·斯万克主演了一部惊悚片，故事发生在午夜太阳不落的土地上，在这里，连强硬警察的心智也可能被失眠症所吞噬。在阿拉斯加永恒阳光的炙烤下，两名洛杉矶警察老兵正在逼近一名少女谋杀案的嫌疑人。但当警官威尔·多默（帕西诺饰）不小心击中搭档时，他们的谋杀嫌疑人、深居简出的小说家沃尔特·芬奇（威廉姆斯饰）目睹了枪击事件，并以此勒索多默。现在，随着一位理想主义的本地侦探（斯万克饰）对案件展开调查，赌注不断加码，多默的理智也开始崩溃。
umc.cmc.3sr644gks0beiq8og6ax314ww.original: Academy Award winners Robin Williams, Al Pacino and Hilary Swank star in a thriller set in the land of the midnight sun, where a the mind of even a tough cop can be threatened by Insomnia. Under the glare of the permanent Alaska sun, two veteran Los Angeles police officers close in on their suspect in the murder of a teenage girl. But when officer Will Dormer (Pacino) accidentally shoots his partner, their murder suspect, reclusive novelist Walter Finch (Williams), witnesses the shooting--and blackmails Dormer. Now, as an idealistic local detective (Swank) investigates the case, and the stakes rise, Dormer's sanity begins to falter.

umc.cmc.5iudnxk9tyxo63gewawi330mw.text: 本·斯蒂勒、杰克·布莱克和小罗伯特·唐尼领衔主演群星云集的《热带惊雷》，这是一部动作喜剧，讲述了一群自以为是的演员着手拍摄史上最昂贵的战争电影的故事。由于成本激增迫使制片厂取消了这部电影，沮丧的导演拒绝停止拍摄，把他的演员带入了东南亚的丛林，在那里他们遇到了真正的坏蛋。
umc.cmc.5iudnxk9tyxo63gewawi330mw.original: Ben Stiller, Jack Black and Robert Downey Jr. lead an ensemble cast in "Tropic Thunder," an action comedy about a group of self-absorbed actors who set out to make the most expensive war film. After ballooning costs force the studio to cancel the movie, the frustrated director refuses to stop shooting, leading his cast into the jungles of Southeast Asia, where they encounter real bad guys.

umc.cmc.6o1742rqdwxl2dxav5trdajut.text: 一名医务室病人从昏迷中醒来，发现自己身处空无一人的房间……空旷的医院……荒凉的城市。一种强大的病毒将受害者锁在永久的嗜血狂怒状态中，将他周围的世界变成了一个看似荒凉的不毛之地。现在，少数幸存者必须为生存而战，却不知道最糟糕的还在后头……
umc.cmc.6o1742rqdwxl2dxav5trdajut.original: An infirmary patient awakens from a coma to an empty room...in a vacant hospital...in a deserted city. A powerful virus, which locks victims into a permanent state of murderous rage, has transformed the world around him into a seemingly desolate wasteland. Now a handful of survivors must fight to stay alive, unaware that the worst is yet to come...

umc.cmc.54i1kouogtrem4mgqc068agfk.text: 《黑鹰坠落》动作场面密集，真实且令人揪心地记录了美军在索马里摩加迪沙的军事行动。作为联合国维和部队的一部分，一队美国精锐士兵执行任务，旨在绑架索马里军阀的几位高级副官，以制止这个四分五裂的国家旷日持久的内战。精心策划的任务出了大错，导致美军经历了自越南战争以来最大规模的单场交火。由著名动作制片人杰瑞·布鲁克海默和备受赞誉的动作导演雷德利·斯科特联手打造。
umc.cmc.54i1kouogtrem4mgqc068agfk.original: Black Hawk Down is the action packed true harrowing account of US Military action in Mogadishu, Somalia. As part of a UN Peacekeeping force, a group of elite US soldiers undertake a mission to abduct several top lieutenants of a Somalian warlord to stop the civil war that has been tearing the country apart. The carefully planned mission goes terribly wrong, resulting in the US military's single biggest firefight since Vietnam. From famed action producer Jerry Bruckheimer and acclaimed action director Ridley Scott.

umc.cmc.3xurji5y3xzb0sjj3xwc6s868.text: 身败名裂的财经记者米凯尔·布洛姆奎斯特（丹尼尔·克雷格饰）在被富有瑞典实业家亨里克·范格（克里斯托弗·普卢默饰）雇佣去调查范格侄女海莉40年前的谋杀案后，找到了救赎名誉的机会。范格坚信海莉是被自己家族的某个人杀害的。最终加入布洛姆奎斯特踏上寻找真相的危险征途的是莉丝贝丝·萨兰德（鲁妮·玛拉饰），一个不同寻常但足智多谋的调查员，她那脆弱的信任并不容易赢得。
umc.cmc.3xurji5y3xzb0sjj3xwc6s868.original: Disgraced financial reporter Mikael Blomkvist (Daniel Craig) finds a chance to redeem his honor after being hired by wealthy Swedish industrialist Henrik Vanger (Christopher Plummer) to solve the 40-year-old murder of Vanger's niece, Harriet. Vanger believes that Harriet was killed by a member of his own family. Eventually joining Blomkvist on his dangerous quest for the truth is Lisbeth Salander (Rooney Mara), an unusual but ingenious investigator whose fragile trust is not easily won.

umc.cmc.2j3fje2s0rh78ius1k1kil5tr.text: 年幼的科尔·希尔（海利·乔·奥斯蒙饰）被一个黑暗的秘密所困扰：他能看见鬼魂。那些带着未了心愿从阴影中现身的鬼魂让科尔感到恐惧。他害怕得不敢向任何人吐露内心的痛苦，除了儿童心理学家马尔科姆·克劳博士（布鲁斯·威利斯饰）。正当克劳博士试图揭开科尔超自然能力的真相时，对客户和治疗师而言，其结果都是一次震撼，让他们俩都觉醒并意识到了某种无法解释的事物。
umc.cmc.2j3fje2s0rh78ius1k1kil5tr.original: Young Cole Sear (Haley Joel Osment) is haunted by a dark secret: he is visited by ghosts. Cole is frightened by visitations from those with unresolved problems who appear from the shadows. He is too afraid to tell anyone about his anguish, except child psychologist Dr. Malcolm Crowe (Bruce Willis). As Dr. Crowe tries to uncover the truth about Cole's supernatural abilities, the consequences for client and therapist are a jolt that awakens them both to something unexplainable.

umc.cmc.4fps2u7wpcpuv5uenubediwct.text: 艾琳（德鲁·巴里摩尔）诙谐的机智和直言不讳的坦率，在第二天早上的啤酒、酒吧冷知识问答和早餐中，迷住了刚刚恢复单身的加勒特（贾斯汀·朗）。他们之间的化学反应擦出了热烈的夏日恋情火花，但随着艾琳回旧金山而加勒特留在纽约工作，谁也没有料到这段感情能持久。但是，当六周在城市里的纵情玩乐无意间变得意义非凡时，两人都不确定他们是否想要这段感情结束。虽然加勒特的哥们儿博克斯（杰森·苏戴奇斯）和丹（查理·戴）拿他登机前的卡路里控制以及他与手机的全职恋爱开玩笑，但他们并不想失去自己最好的酒友，去成全又一段摇摇欲坠的浪漫。与此同时，艾琳神经质、过度保护已婚的姐姐科琳（克莉丝汀·艾伯盖特）则想阻止艾琳走上一条再熟悉不过的老路。但尽管有着海岸相隔、唱反调的朋友和家人以及一些意想不到的诱惑，这对情侣可能还是会坚持到底。
umc.cmc.4fps2u7wpcpuv5uenubediwct.original: Erin's (Drew Barrymore) wry wit and unfiltered frankness charm newly single Garrett (Justin Long) over beer, bar trivia and breakfast the next morning. Their chemistry sparks a full-fledged summer fling, but neither expects it to last once Erin heads home to San Francisco and Garrett stays behind for his job in New York City. But when six weeks of romping through the city inadvertently become meaningful, neither is sure they want it to end. And while Garrett's friends, Box (Jason Sudeikis) and Dan (Charlie Day), joke about his pre-flight calorie-cutting and his full-time relationship with his cell phone, they don't like losing their best drinking buddy to yet another rocky romance. At the same time, Erin's high-strung, overprotective married sister, Corrine (Christina Applegate), wants to keep Erin from heading down an all-too-familiar road. But despite the opposite coasts, the nay-saying friends and family, and a few unexpected temptations, the couple just might go the distance.

umc.cmc.6x263wzi05ds2h4oen54w8881.text: 侏罗纪世界豪华度假村位于哥斯达黎加海岸附近，为各种基因工程恐龙提供栖息地，其中包括凶猛而聪明的暴虐霸王龙。当这只庞大的生物逃脱时，引发了一系列连锁反应，导致其他恐龙疯狂横行。现在，全靠前军人兼动物专家（克里斯·帕特饰）利用他的特殊技能，从一场全力以赴的史前袭击中拯救两个小兄弟和其余游客。
umc.cmc.6x263wzi05ds2h4oen54w8881.original: Located off the coast of Costa Rica, the Jurassic World luxury resort provides a habitat for an array of genetically engineered dinosaurs, including the vicious and intelligent Indominus rex. When the massive creature escapes, it sets off a chain reaction that causes the other dinos to run amok. Now, it's up to a former military man and animal expert (Chris Pratt) to use his special skills to save two young brothers and the rest of the tourists from an all-out, prehistoric assault.

umc.cmc.38xvbpqapyw5yrpq36aq49ox6.text: 奥斯卡奖得主丹泽尔·华盛顿和罗素·克劳与导演雷德利·斯科特（《角斗士》）合作，带来这部既有力量又真实的史诗故事。犯罪头目弗兰克·卢卡斯（华盛顿饰）凭借冷酷无情的街头战术和强烈的荣誉感，统治着哈林区混乱的毒品地下世界。当被排挤的警察里奇·罗伯茨（克劳饰）着手打垮卢卡斯的数百万美元帝国时，两人陷入了一场传奇的对决。《美国黑帮》是一部“残酷而 brilhante 的电影”（皮特·哈蒙德，《Maxim》）
umc.cmc.38xvbpqapyw5yrpq36aq49ox6.original: Academy Award winners Denzel Washington and Russell Crowe team with director Ridley Scott (Gladiator) for an epic story as powerful as it is true. Armed with ruthless, street-wise tactics and a strict sense of honor, crime boss Frank Lucas (Washington) rules Harlem's chaotic drug underworld. When outcast cop Richie Roberts (Crowe) sets out to bring down Lucas's multi-million dollar empire, it plunges both men into a legendary confrontation. American Gangster is "a brutal and brilliant film" (Pete Hammond, Maxim)

umc.cmc.2nmvx85jvka8bkq435m65obfz.text: “幸运”杰克·奥布里舰长（罗素·克劳饰）是英国海军中著名的功勋舰长。但当他的舰艇“惊奇号”突然遭到强大敌人的袭击时，奥布里在职责与友情之间陷入两难，他在两片大洋中展开高风险的追逐，以拦截并俘获敌人。面对一艘严重受损的舰艇和受伤的船员，这次任务可以拯救他的声誉，或者将他们全部毁灭。荣获10项奥斯卡奖提名，包括最佳影片！
umc.cmc.2nmvx85jvka8bkq435m65obfz.original: Captain “Lucky” Jack Aubrey (Russell Crowe) is a renowned fighting captain in the British Navy. But when his ship, the Surprise, is suddenly attacked by a superior enemy, Aubrey is torn between duty and friendship as he pursues a high-stakes chase across two oceans to intercept and capture his foe. With a badly damaged ship and an injured crew, this mission can save his reputation, or destroy them all. Nominated for 10 Academy Awards, including Best Picture!

umc.cmc.gks6zztq8kxlbjnrhjhjj26z.text: 奥斯卡奖得主丹泽尔·华盛顿在悬疑惊悚片《fallen》中饰演一位顽强的凶杀案侦探，陷入难以想象的邪恶魔掌之中。约翰·霍布斯侦探（华盛顿饰）和他的搭档琼斯（约翰·古德曼饰）抓获了一名恶魔连环杀手并目睹了他的处决，但可怕的谋杀案仍在继续。这些新的谋杀案是指向一个模仿杀手，还是更邪恶的东西？随着调查的展开，霍布斯的上司斯坦顿中尉（唐纳德·萨瑟兰）有了一个可怕的发现。现在，霍布斯侦探在与堕落者心灵深处的邪恶作斗争时，不得不面对一个又一个清醒的噩梦。
umc.cmc.gks6zztq8kxlbjnrhjhjj26z.original: Academy Award-winner Denzel Washington stars as a tenacious homicide detective caught in the grasp of unimaginable evil in the suspense-thriller Fallen. Detective John Hobbes (Washington) and his partner, Jonesy (John Goodman), apprehend a demonic serial killer and witness his execution--but the grisly murders continue. Do these new slayings point to a copycat killer--or something even more sinister? As the investigation unfolds, Hobbes' superior officer, Lieutenant Stanton (Donald Sutherland), makes a frightening discovery. Now, Detective Hobbes confronts one waking nightmare after another as he battles the evil that dwells within the hearts and souls of the Fallen.

umc.cmc.3dnsidxjodrqqk4eqg8i5wg8r.text: 饱受失眠困扰的孤僻者特拉维斯·比克尔（罗伯特·德尼罗饰）在纽约市找到了一份出租车司机的工作，每晚在街头游荡，随着他梦想清理这座肮脏的城市，他与现实的距离也越来越远。当特拉维斯遇到漂亮的竞选工作人员贝茜（西碧尔·谢帕德饰）时，他沉迷于拯救世界的想法，首先策划暗杀总统候选人，然后将注意力转向营救12岁的妓女爱丽丝（朱迪·福斯特饰）。
umc.cmc.3dnsidxjodrqqk4eqg8i5wg8r.original: Suffering from insomnia, disturbed loner Travis Bickle (Robert De Niro) takes a job as a New York City cabbie, haunting the streets nightly, growing increasingly detached from reality as he dreams of cleaning up the filthy city. When Travis meets pretty campaign worker Betsy (Cybill Shepherd), he becomes obsessed with the idea of saving the world, first plotting to assassinate a presidential candidate, then directing his attentions toward rescuing 12-year-old prostitute Iris (Jodie Foster).

umc.cmc.3ich7f8sravd24iswc9hqq54o.text: 当威尔（瑞安·雷诺兹饰）决定向女儿（阿比盖尔·布斯林饰）讲述他是如何遇到她母亲的故事时，他发现重新审视过去也可能给他第二次获得未来的机会。由伊丽莎白·班克斯、蕾切尔·薇兹和艾拉·菲舍尔共同主演，这是一个温馨的故事，让你意识到回头绝对为时不晚……也许还能找到一个幸福的结局。
umc.cmc.3ich7f8sravd24iswc9hqq54o.original: When Will (Ryan Reynolds) decides to tell his daughter (Abigail Breslin) the story of how he met her mother, he discovers that a second look at the past might also give him a second chance at the future. Co-starring Elizabeth Banks, Rachel Weisz and Isla Fisher, it's the heartwarming story that makes you realize it's definitely never too late to go back…and maybe find a happy ending.

umc.cmc.2iqk0c0jh9ocfk2jtv2yda0k1.text: 一部受小约翰·福布斯·纳什生活中的事件启发的人性戏剧，部分基于西尔维娅·纳萨尔的传记《美丽心灵》。从声名狼藉的高峰到堕落的深渊，小约翰·福布斯·纳什经历了一切。作为一个数学天才，他在职业生涯早期就有了惊人的发现，并站在了国际声誉的边缘。但这位英俊而傲慢的纳什很快发现自己踏上了一段痛苦而令人心碎的自我发现之旅。
umc.cmc.2iqk0c0jh9ocfk2jtv2yda0k1.original: A human drama inspired by events in the life of John Forbes Nash Jr., and in part based on the biography "A Beautiful Mind" by Sylvia Nasar. From the heights of notoriety to the depths of depravity, John Forbes Nash Jr. experienced it all. A mathematical genius, he made an astonishing discovery early in his career and stood on the brink of international acclaim. But the handsome and arrogant Nash soon found himself on a painful and harrowing journey of self-discovery.

umc.cmc.2ep1vwlxkikhdettd106s2qhc.text: 汤姆·汉克斯、吉娜·戴维斯和麦当娜主演了这部来自曾为您带来《飞越未来》的团队的大联盟喜剧。汉克斯饰演吉米·杜根，一个大联盟生涯已经结束的过气球星。在男职业球员参战期间，杜根被聘请在1943年全美女子棒球联盟中担任教练，他发现自己被全女子球队的勇气和英雄主义重新吸引回了比赛。乔恩·洛威茨饰演的讽刺球探抢尽了风头，他招募了多蒂·辛森（吉娜·戴维斯），一个拥有贝比·鲁斯挥棒动作的棒球娃娃。队友麦当娜、洛丽·佩蒂和罗西·奥唐纳完善了阵容，带领球队进入世界大赛。改编自先驱女性在场内场外为数代运动员开辟道路的真实故事。
umc.cmc.2ep1vwlxkikhdettd106s2qhc.original: Tom Hanks, Geena Davis and Madonna star in this major-league comedy from the team that brought you Big. Hanks stars as Jimmy Dugan, a washed-up ballplayer whose big league days are over. Hired to coach in the All-American Girls Baseball League of 1943, while the male pros are at war, Dugan finds himself drawn back into the game by the heart and heroics of his all-girl team. Jon Lovitz adds a scene-stealing cameo as the sarcastic scout who recruits Dottie Hinson (Geena Davis), the baseball dolly with a Babe Ruth swing. Teammates Madonna, Lori Petty and Rosie O'Donnell round out the roster, taking the team to the World Series. Based on the true story of the pioneering women who blazed the trail, on the fields and off, for generations of athletes.

umc.cmc.59i5501mld9dk1cle3fo8zy4d.text: 一名高中棒球队教练在进入大联盟前受伤，当他同意参加大联盟试训时，迎来了职业投球生涯的第二次机会，但前提是其常年失利的球队必须赢得地区冠军。
umc.cmc.59i5501mld9dk1cle3fo8zy4d.original: A high school baseball coach, injured before making it to the big leagues, gets a second chance at a professional pitching career when he agrees to try out for the majors, but only if his perpetually losing team wins the district championship.

umc.cmc.3eh9r5iz32ggdm4ccvw5igiir.text: 荣获 3 项奥斯卡®奖，包括最佳影片和最佳男配角。作为聋哑人家庭的孩子 (CODA)，露比是家里唯一听力正常的人。当她发现自己对歌唱的热情时，露比必须在家庭责任和自己的梦想之间做出选择。
umc.cmc.3eh9r5iz32ggdm4ccvw5igiir.original: Winner of 3 Oscars®, including Best Picture and Best Supporting Actor. As a CODA (child of deaf adults), Ruby is the only hearing person in her home. When she discovers a passion for singing, Ruby must choose between family obligations and her dreams.

umc.cmc.262n0v53nmotkz7ulzuuco7rq.text: 这部托尼奖获奖音乐剧百老汇现场拍摄版，讲述了一个非凡的真实故事：2001年9月11日，38个航班在一个加拿大的小镇迫降。当地人接待了这些“远道而来的人”，他们聚在一起并找到了希望。
umc.cmc.262n0v53nmotkz7ulzuuco7rq.original: Filmed live on Broadway, the Tony Award-winning musical tells the remarkable true story of 38 flights grounded in a small Canadian town on September 11, 2001. As the locals host these “come from aways,” they come together and find hope.

umc.cmc.30p2zn6vd14159dorn1vo68el.text: 詹妮弗·劳伦斯饰演林西，一名在经历创伤性伤病后，在回到新后、艰难适应新奥尔良家乡生活的士兵。当她遇到当地机械师詹姆斯（布莱恩·泰里·亨利饰）时，两人开始建立起一种意想不到的联系。
umc.cmc.30p2zn6vd14159dorn1vo68el.original: Jennifer Lawrence stars as Lynsey, a soldier struggling to adjust back home in New Orleans following a traumatic injury. When she meets local mechanic James (Brian Tyree Henry), the pair begin to forge an unexpected bond.

umc.cmc.6loo9fah7vwj2zpp7ehactlpd.text: 大学刚毕业、困在新泽西家中且前路迷茫的 22 岁青年安德鲁，开始为犹太成人礼担任派对暖场员，并在那里与一位年轻妈妈和她十几岁的女儿结下了独特的友谊。
umc.cmc.6loo9fah7vwj2zpp7ehactlpd.original: Fresh out of college and stuck at his New Jersey home without a clear path forward, 22-year-old Andrew begins working as a party starter for bar/bat mitzvahs—where he strikes up a unique friendship with a young mom and her teenage daughter.

umc.cmc.37d0bk971uulosq5inlm3ikb1.text: 在姐姐失踪后，杰克斯（莉莉·格莱斯顿饰）和她的侄女罗基必须相依为命。为了拼死保全破碎的家，杰克斯和罗基无视法律，踏上了前往俄克拉荷马城参加“大国”传统欢庆会的旅程。
umc.cmc.37d0bk971uulosq5inlm3ikb1.original: Following her sister’s disappearance, Jax (Lily Gladstone) and her niece Roki must stick together. Desperate to keep what’s left of their family intact, Jax and Roki defy the law and hit the road on a journey to the Grand Nation Powwow in Oklahoma City.

umc.cmc.22xahad7xeqkok7u24xk0e788.text: 莱妮是一名正为姐姐离世而悲痛的少年音乐神童，她发现自己夹在学校里新来的男生和姐姐悲痛欲绝的男友之间。凭借生动的想象力和矛盾的内心，莱妮度过了初恋和初次失去的时光。
umc.cmc.22xahad7xeqkok7u24xk0e788.original: Lennie is a teen musical prodigy grieving the death of her sister when she finds herself caught between a new guy at school and her sister's devastated boyfriend. Through her vivid imagination and conflicted heart, Lennie navigates first love and first loss.

umc.cmc.3lp7wqowerzdbej98tveildi3.text: 想象一下查尔斯·狄更斯那个温馨感人的故事：一个吝啬鬼在平安夜遭到四个幽灵的造访——但更有趣。还有威尔·法瑞尔、瑞安·雷诺兹和奥克塔维亚·斯宾瑟。此外，还有盛大的歌舞表演。好吧，我们的要求有点多。也许看下预告片就行？
umc.cmc.3lp7wqowerzdbej98tveildi3.original: Imagine Charles Dickens’ heartwarming tale of a scrooge visited by four ghosts on Christmas Eve—but funnier. And with Will Ferrell, Ryan Reynolds, and Octavia Spencer. Also, huge musical numbers. Okay, we’re asking a lot. Maybe just watch the trailer?

umc.cmc.1mzq8kys0zfx8kl7fmam7kuku.text: 与荣获艾美奖®的明星汉娜·沃丁厄姆一起欢度节日，她将在伦敦大剧院迎接特邀嘉宾，呈现一场精彩绝伦的音乐盛宴。
umc.cmc.1mzq8kys0zfx8kl7fmam7kuku.original: Ring in the holidays with Emmy®-winning star Hannah Waddingham as she welcomes special guests for a musical extravaganza at the London Coliseum.

umc.cmc.750u3qv5wz0d41pn1v2rvn7oe.text: 詹姆斯·柯登将钥匙交给了赞恩·洛，开启这场国际节日公路旅行。当赞恩在日本与杜阿·利帕、在密苏里州家乡与查普尔·罗恩、在洛杉矶与Lady Gaga共度佳节时，这里便成了流行天后的冬日仙境。
umc.cmc.750u3qv5wz0d41pn1v2rvn7oe.original: James Corden passes the keys to Zane Lowe for this international holiday road trip. It’s a pop diva winter wonderland when Zane gets festive with Dua Lipa in Japan, Chappell Roan in her Missouri hometown, and Lady Gaga in Los Angeles.

umc.cmc.3mkaxf4ege0ytr5ycan41jzjb.text: 同父异母的兄弟雷蒙德和雷在疏远的父亲去世后重聚，并发现他最后的愿望是让他们为他挖墓。他们共同审视了自己作为男人的成长，既因父亲而起，也与父亲无关。
umc.cmc.3mkaxf4ege0ytr5ycan41jzjb.original: Half brothers Raymond and Ray reunite when their estranged father dies—and discover that his final wish was for them to dig his grave. Together, they process who they’ve become as men, both because of their father and in spite of him.

umc.cmc.58su2j1i0etuvq64m6nxfm11y.text: 见证梅西转会至国际迈阿密后引发的轰动全球的媒体狂潮，以及它在足球世界中掀起的波澜。
umc.cmc.58su2j1i0etuvq64m6nxfm11y.original: Witness the media craze that followed Messi's transformative move to Inter Miami CF and the ripple effect it sent through the world of soccer.

umc.cmc.13tm01bb2zcat3s04rxgju0zh.text: 重温圣迭戈激动人心的官宣时刻，美国职业足球大联盟迎来其第三十家俱乐部。
umc.cmc.13tm01bb2zcat3s04rxgju0zh.original: Relive San Diego's epic announcement as Major League Soccer welcomes its thirtieth club.

umc.cmc.12pym1hetoynay361npi90btj.text: 一次母女海外度假发生了毁灭性的转折，Gali因涉嫌藏毒被捕。她的母亲Orna拒绝接受这些指控，为寻求自由押上了一切——却反而陷入了Gali的秘密网络之中。
umc.cmc.12pym1hetoynay361npi90btj.original: A mother-daughter vacation abroad takes a devastating turn when Gali is arrested for drug possession. Refusing to accept the charges, her mother Orna risks everything on a quest for freedom—only to get entangled in a web of Gali’s secrets.

umc.cmc.6wgw0u6vuwydp6obbzzccup3w.text: Margo是一位前Hooters女服务员和前职业摔跤手的女儿，也是一名刚从大学辍学的有志作家。面对一个新生婴儿、如山般堆积的账单以及越来越少的支付账单的方法，Margo必须找到前进的道路。
umc.cmc.6wgw0u6vuwydp6obbzzccup3w.original: The daughter of a former Hooters waitress and an ex-pro wrestler, Margo is a recent college dropout and aspiring writer. Faced with a new baby, mounting pile of bills, and dwindling number of ways to pay them, Margo must find a way forward.

umc.cmc.3uvjztuy2y8ve2rj6nvgyop89.text: Reef Hawk自六岁起就是好莱坞的代言人，他的状态并不好。当得知一桩与神秘视频有关的勒索阴谋时，Reef先发制人地踏上了救赎之旅，以弥补过错、直面内心的恶魔，并避免遭到封杀。
umc.cmc.3uvjztuy2y8ve2rj6nvgyop89.original: Reef Hawk, Hollywood’s poster child since age six, is not okay. When he learns about an extortion plot tied to a mysterious video, Reef preemptively sets out on a redemption tour to make amends, confront his demons, and avoid getting canceled.

umc.cmc.dsa24wciry96i1e8dcq0b9sm.text: 与天竺鼠Izzy、小兔Zuri以及蛇Tate一起携手展开英勇的冒险——这三个纽约市教室宠物组成的歌剧三重唱，响应着来自世界各地处于困境中的动物们的呼唤。
umc.cmc.dsa24wciry96i1e8dcq0b9sm.original: Team up for heroic adventures with Izzy the Guinea Pig, Zuri the Bunny, and Tate the Snake—a trio of opera-singing New York City classroom pets—as they answer calls from animals in need all around the world.

umc.cmc.633pbtki99m7e8lc9ybbyab3.text: 奥斯卡金像奖®获得者埃罗尔·莫里斯（Errol Morris）揭开了大卫·康威尔（David Cornwell）传奇一生的神秘面纱。他曾是一名间谍，在文学界则以约翰·勒卡雷（John le Carré）之名广为人知。
umc.cmc.633pbtki99m7e8lc9ybbyab3.original: Academy Award® winner Errol Morris pulls back the curtain on the storied life and career of David Cornwell, the former spy known to the literary world as John le Carré.

umc.cmc.39yw4dp13gshxq5bt9fsl0o5y.text: 经过多年的聚光灯追逐，赛琳娜·戈麦斯（Selena Gomez）取得了难以想象的巨大名气。然而，正当她达到新的巅峰时，一场意料之外的变故将她拉入黑暗。这部风格独特、真实且亲密的纪录片记录了她历时六年重返光明之旅。
umc.cmc.39yw4dp13gshxq5bt9fsl0o5y.original: After years in the limelight, Selena Gomez achieves unimaginable stardom. But just as she reaches a new peak, an unexpected turn pulls her into darkness. This uniquely raw and intimate documentary spans her six-year journey into a new light.

umc.cmc.69ic79cvvy80epfhz5efdgjjd.text: 在这部首次讲述其故事的重大纪录片中，领略标志性摇滚乐队的传奇遗产。由托德·海因斯（Todd Haynes）以那个时代的前卫精神执导，这部万花筒般的口述历史将独家采访与令人炫目的档案影像结合在一起。
umc.cmc.69ic79cvvy80epfhz5efdgjjd.original: Experience the iconic rock band's legacy in the first major documentary to tell their story. Directed with the era’s avant-garde spirit by Todd Haynes, this kaleidoscopic oral history combines exclusive interviews with dazzling archival footage.

umc.cmc.5waz3hfo9r1133t8arap8b6nq.text: 深入而私密地了解非凡的青少年比利·埃利什（Billie Eilish）。获奖电影制作人R·J·卡特勒（R.J. Cutler）跟随她在巡演路上、舞台上以及在家中与家人在一起的旅程，而她的首张专辑的创作和录制改变了她的人生。
umc.cmc.5waz3hfo9r1133t8arap8b6nq.original: Take a deeply personal look at extraordinary teenager Billie Eilish. Award-winning filmmaker R.J. Cutler follows her journey on the road, onstage, and at home with her family as the writing and recording of her debut album changes her life.

umc.cmc.73wmdmkfpta5ul1vbwckmme39.text: 在20世纪70年代的墨西哥，四名女性打破极保守的规范，加入了第一支女子警察部队——却发现这只是一场用于转移公众对连环杀手视线的噱头。随着尸体数量不断增加，她们誓言将凶手绳之以法。灵感源自真实事件。
umc.cmc.73wmdmkfpta5ul1vbwckmme39.original: In 1970s Mexico, four women defy ultraconservative norms and join the first female police force—only to discover it’s a publicity stunt to distract from a serial killer. As the body count grows, they vow to bring the killer to justice. Inspired by true events.

umc.cmc.52sgmi3vdpedurrbtz6louqqo.text: 史努比心爱的狗屋失踪了，他试图将它找回，并懂得了是什么让一所房子有了家的感觉。
umc.cmc.52sgmi3vdpedurrbtz6louqqo.original: When Snoopy’s beloved doghouse goes missing, he tries to track it down, and learns what makes a house feel like home.

umc.cmc.5tugaz9vt498ajn7q64ypaqxn.text: 达斯蒂·“铁锤”·博伊德是一名过气的网球职业选手，非常需要一场胜利。为了拯救一家经营困难乡村俱乐部并赢得父亲的尊重，达斯蒂打破了神圣的誓言，做了一件不可思议的事：他去打匹克球了。
umc.cmc.5tugaz9vt498ajn7q64ypaqxn.original: Dusty “The Hammer” Boyd, a washed-up tennis pro, could really use a win. On a quest to save a struggling country club and earn his father’s respect, Dusty breaks a sacred vow and does the unthinkable: He plays pickleball.

umc.cmc.6muy4la7lj1omu5nci4bt2m66.text: 尼基和杰森梦寐以求的就是一个孩子——偏偏这是他们无法拥有的。于是他们决定领养。面对他们那不靠谱的朋友、戏剧化的亲戚和混乱的生活，这对夫妇能成功建立他们梦想中的家庭吗？
umc.cmc.6muy4la7lj1omu5nci4bt2m66.original: All Nikki and Jason want is a baby—the one thing they can’t have. So they decide to adopt. With their dysfunctional friends, dramatic relatives, and chaotic lives, will the couple succeed in building the family of their dreams?

umc.cmc.4erhnrmkf9vgeojl3uryxsc0j.text: 在发现自己的队伍面临解散的危险后，史努比和小猎犬侦察队出发前往广袤的户外去赢取徽章。与此同时，查理·布朗和朋友们在斯普林湖营地享受他们的夏天。
umc.cmc.4erhnrmkf9vgeojl3uryxsc0j.original: After discovering their troop is in danger of disbanding, Snoopy and the Beagle Scouts set off to the great outdoors to earn their badges. Meanwhile, Charlie Brown and friends enjoy their summer at Camp Spring Lake.

umc.cmc.10k6tes7rmc2ti0ho1ozgwezc.text: 一位刚离婚的妈妈陷入了由勒索、谋杀和青少年足球交织而成的危险深渊。
umc.cmc.10k6tes7rmc2ti0ho1ozgwezc.original: A newly divorced mom falls down a dangerous rabbit hole of blackmail, murder, and youth soccer.

umc.cmc.4w9agfyrx2fgc5k9rls2cffho.text: 当打猎途中的朋友们与其它猎人发生致命冲突时，他们发誓保守秘密。但随着多疑情绪的滋生——以及一个冷酷无情的帮派寻求报复——朋友们必须面对他们的道德、家庭和野蛮本能。
umc.cmc.4w9agfyrx2fgc5k9rls2cffho.original: When friends on a hunting trip get into a deadly clash with other hunters, they vow to keep it a secret. But as paranoia sets in—and a ruthless gang seeks revenge—the friends must confront their morality, families, and savage instincts.

umc.cmc.4lh4bmztauvkooqz400akxav.text: 在这部由乔恩·费儒和《地球脉动》制作人联手打造的史诗级系列片中，以全新视角体验我们世界的奇观。回到雄伟的恐龙和非凡的生物漫游于陆地、海洋和天空的时代。
umc.cmc.4lh4bmztauvkooqz400akxav.original: Experience the wonders of our world like never before in this epic series from Jon Favreau and the producers of Planet Earth. Travel back to a time when majestic dinosaurs and extraordinary creatures roamed the lands, seas, and skies.

umc.cmc.xesgxj0bt8yrrkrunae0wke7.text: 查理·布朗和伙伴们前往夏令营，空气中弥漫着音乐与欢乐。初次参加的莎莉不明白这有什么好兴奋的。但当夏令营面临被迫关闭的危机时，他们齐心协力将其拯救，以便更多的孩子能够留下属于自己的特殊回忆。
umc.cmc.xesgxj0bt8yrrkrunae0wke7.original: Music and glee fill the air as Charlie Brown and the gang head off to summer camp. First-timer Sally doesn’t get what all the hype is about. But when the camp may be forced to close, they team up to save it so more kids can make their own special memories.

umc.cmc.2zky8t1ps9m3ld18tdjc1g5di.text: 劳尔的世界正在瓦解。玛尔塔意外怀孕了。在一次葬礼上浪漫邂逅将他们聚在一起后，他们在生活和爱情的混乱中跌跌撞撞前行。
umc.cmc.2zky8t1ps9m3ld18tdjc1g5di.original: Raúl’s world is unraveling. Marta’s unexpectedly pregnant. After a funeral meet-cute brings them together, they stumble through the chaos of life and love.

umc.cmc.7ad5xech8wu5nh2p221ymy9r2.text: 一辆公共汽车被三名劫匪劫持，但他们在逃脱之前就丧命了。每位乘客的说法都一样：一个戴连帽衫的男人拯救了大家。随着案件的展开，英雄与罪犯之间的界限开始模糊。
umc.cmc.7ad5xech8wu5nh2p221ymy9r2.original: A bus is hijacked by three robbers—who end up dead before they can get away. Every passenger’s story is the same: a hooded man saved the day. As the case unfolds, the line between hero and criminal begins to blur.

umc.cmc.yy12locz1vttqczsnlnwtei3.text: 富兰克林刚来到镇上，希望能交到朋友，但他惯用的伎俩在花生帮身上不管用。当肥皂盒车大赛到来时，他确信这是一个给新伙伴留下深刻印象的机会，于是与另一个落单的孩子查理·布朗组成了搭档。
umc.cmc.yy12locz1vttqczsnlnwtei3.original: Franklin is new to town and hoping to make friends, but his usual tactics don’t work on the Peanuts gang. When the Soap Box Derby arrives, he’s sure it’s a chance to impress new pals and teams up with the only other unpartnered kid: Charlie Brown.

umc.cmc.5kr10v39ex4n13rrwxjzm3jy7.text: 安娜和瑞安通过一项充满争议的测试，证明了他们找到了真爱。只有一个问题：安娜仍然不确定。这时，她遇到了阿米尔。
umc.cmc.5kr10v39ex4n13rrwxjzm3jy7.original: Anna and Ryan have found true love together. It’s been proven by a controversial test. There’s just one problem: Anna still isn’t sure. Then she meets Amir.

umc.cmc.1a1h3avg5tx7g68ws3y06ty17.text: 安静、善良的内向女孩玛西有很多出色的点子，可以帮朋友们实现目标并解决问题。但当世界开始关注她、聚光灯落在她身上时，分享这些想法却成了一种挑战。
umc.cmc.1a1h3avg5tx7g68ws3y06ty17.original: Quiet, kindhearted introvert Marcie has lots of brilliant ideas to help her friends achieve goals and solve problems. But when the world takes notice and the spotlight lands on her, sharing those ideas becomes a challenge.

umc.cmc.njewt06q05vqbgp6w42pqb0l.text: 一个来自加拿大军事基地的个头不高的孩子成为了20世纪80年代国际流行文化宠儿，却发现自己的人生轨迹因一个惊人的诊断结果而改变。当一个不可救药的乐观主义者遭遇不治之症时，会发生什么？
umc.cmc.njewt06q05vqbgp6w42pqb0l.original: A short kid from a Canadian army base becomes the international pop culture darling of the 1980s—only to find the course of his life altered by a stunning diagnosis. What happens when an incurable optimist confronts an incurable disease?

umc.cmc.1w3e47nmnt4o304oaauh4k2rm.text: 在大学毕业前夕，六个最好的朋友踏上了一个史诗般的周末来庆祝，却发生了致命的转折。将近 20 年后，幸存者们因为一条威胁要揭露那个命运之夜真相的勒索短信而不情愿地重聚。
umc.cmc.1w3e47nmnt4o304oaauh4k2rm.original: On the eve of college graduation, six best friends embark on an epic weekend to celebrate—but it takes a fatal turn. Nearly 20 years later, the survivors are reluctantly reunited by a blackmail text threatening to expose the truth about that fateful night.

umc.cmc.gr1rsr9lp2tzfwb0w6zhq9y3.text: 查理·布朗决心赢得这场重要的棒球比赛。但在比赛开始前不久，事情却成了一场惨剧：萨莉与投手丘上的一朵小花结下了不解之缘，并誓死保护它。
umc.cmc.gr1rsr9lp2tzfwb0w6zhq9y3.original: Charlie Brown is determined to win the big baseball game. But things turn into a fiasco right before the matchup, when Sally bonds with a little flower on the pitcher’s mound and vows to protect it at all costs.

umc.cmc.12l86ri6vfjlimw2m8b8dzszs.text: 与史努比一起冲向新领域：太空！在查理·布朗、伍德斯托克和花生帮其他成员的陪伴下，史努比踏上了星际探索与发现的史诗冒险之旅。
umc.cmc.12l86ri6vfjlimw2m8b8dzszs.original: Blast off with Snoopy as he takes on a new frontier: space! Joined by Charlie Brown, Woodstock, and the rest of the Peanuts gang, Snoopy embarks on epic adventures of interstellar exploration and discovery.

umc.cmc.5dba56sgwst50iuh5h9uqpdsq.text: 两位生物学家展开了一项与其研究对象一样宏伟的事业——破译鲸鱼复杂的交流方式。米歇尔·福内特博士和埃伦·加兰博士前往不同的半球，去揭开一个比我们人类古老数亿年的文化。
umc.cmc.5dba56sgwst50iuh5h9uqpdsq.original: Two biologists set out on an undertaking as colossal as their subjects—deciphering the complex communication of whales. Dr. Michelle Fournet and Dr. Ellen Garland journey to opposite hemispheres to uncover a culture eons older than our own.

umc.cmc.4ym1omzf14f4jwcmb7lnu91o0.text: 在一级方程式赛车迎来第 75 个年头之际，新秀们奋起直追，一支曾夺得冠军的车队陷入混乱，一场三方争夺世界冠军的较量正紧紧锁住整个发车区。
umc.cmc.4ym1omzf14f4jwcmb7lnu91o0.original: In Formula 1's 75th year, rookies surge forward and a title-winning team faces turmoil as a three-way contest for the world championship grips the grid.

pr:fleetwood-mac-the-chain.text: 在 1974 年的一次机缘巧合相遇后，Mick Fleetwood、John McVie、Christine McVie、Lindsey Buckingham 和 Stevie Nicks 回顾了他们历时五十多年、毫不妥协的历史，从打破纪录的唱片和巡演（包括从未公开的镜头和独家新采访）一直到今天。这部电影探讨了乐队的艰难险阻、个人韧性和音乐技巧如何结合在一起，创作出经受住时间考验并成为不朽杰作的歌曲。它带领粉丝们领略他们辉煌职业生涯的高潮与低谷，阐明了每位成员为乐队罕见的化学反应带来的非凡要素——这一音乐组合在全球售出了超过 2.2 亿张唱片。这部纪录片探讨了是什么让这群艺术家能够一次又一次地创作出独一无二的音乐作品，以及当来自乐队内外的各种可能压力威胁要将他们分崩离析时，是什么将他们重新拉回并维系在一起。
pr:fleetwood-mac-the-chain.original: Following their fortuitous meeting in 1974, Mick Fleetwood, John McVie, Christine McVie, Lindsey Buckingham and Stevie Nicks reflect on their uncompromising 50-plus-year history, from their record-breaking recordings and tours — including never-before-seen footage and exclusive new interviews — through to today. The film explores how the band’s trials and tribulations, personal resilience and musical dexterity combined to create songs that have stood the test of time and are enduring masterpieces. It takes fans through the highs and lows of their brilliant career, illuminating the exceptional ingredients each member brought to the band’s uncommon alchemy — a musical union that sold more than 220 million records worldwide. The documentary explores what allowed this combination of artists to create singular musical work again and again, and what drew them back together and held them there when every possible pressure, both outside and inside the band, threatened to blow them apart.

pr:snoopy-unleashed.text: 当史努比离家出走时，查理·布朗和花生帮踏上了一段充满情感与奇妙的旅程，前往充满生机的大城市寻找史努比，一路上结识了令人兴奋的新朋友，并发现真正的友谊意味着彼此相爱，正如对方本来的样子。
pr:snoopy-unleashed.original: When Snoopy runs away from home, Charlie Brown and the Peanuts gang go on an emotional and wondrous journey to the vibrant Big City as they search for Snoopy, meet exciting new friends along the way, and discover that real friendship means loving each other just as they are.

pr:fraggle-rock-a-holiday-gift.text: 在这部 Fraggle Rock 节日特辑中，Wembley 被任命为精神队长，并着手在整个 Rock 传播欢乐。但是，当 Fraggles 无意中从 Doc 的工作室拿走了一个珍贵的雪球时，节日的气氛开始消散。Wembley 必须鼓起勇气把它还回去，并懂得善良、给予和帮助需要帮助的人才是节日真正的礼物。
pr:fraggle-rock-a-holiday-gift.original: In this Fraggle Rock holiday special, Wembley is named Spirit Captain and sets out to spread cheer throughout the Rock. But when the Fraggles unknowingly take a cherished snow globe from Doc’s workshop, the holiday spirit begins to fade. Wembley must find the courage to return it, learning that kindness, giving and helping someone in need are the true gifts of the holidays.

pr:fly-me-to-the-moon.text: 由斯嘉丽·约翰逊和查宁·塔图姆主演的《长腿》是一部风格犀利、时尚的喜剧剧情片，故事背景设定在NASA历史性的阿波罗11号登月任务这一高风险的背景下。被请来修复NASA公众形象的市场营销专家凯利·琼斯（约翰逊饰）给发射总监科尔·戴维斯（塔图姆饰）本已十分艰巨的任务制造了混乱，双方擦出了激烈的火花。当白宫认为该任务极其重要不容有失时，琼斯被指派去伪造一场登月作为备用方案，倒计时真正开始了。
pr:fly-me-to-the-moon.original: Starring Scarlett Johansson and Channing Tatum, “Fly Me to the Moon” is a sharp, stylish comedy-drama set against the high-stakes backdrop of NASA’s historic Apollo 11 moon landing. Sparks fly in all directions as marketing maven Kelly Jones (Johansson), brought in to fix NASA’s public image, wreaks havoc on launch director Cole Davis’ (Tatum) already difficult task. When the White House deems the mission too important to fail, Jones is directed to stage a fake moon landing as backup, and the countdown truly begins.

pr:manhunt.text: 根据作家 James L. Swanson 荣获埃德加奖并登上《纽约时报》畅销榜的非小说类书籍改编，“Manhunt”是一部关于历史上最知名却最少被理解的罪行之一的阴谋惊悚片，讲述了亚伯拉罕·林肯遇刺后搜捕约翰·威尔克斯·布思的惊人故事。
pr:manhunt.original: Based on the New York Times bestselling and Edgar Award-winning nonfiction book from author James L. Swanson, “Manhunt” is a conspiracy thriller about one of the best known but least understood crimes in history, the astonishing story of the hunt for John Wilkes Booth in the aftermath of Abraham Lincoln’s assassination.

pr:earthsounds.text: 身临其境的音频揭示了世界各地动物交流的意想不到、陌生且鲜为人知的方式。由汤姆·希德勒斯顿（Tom Hiddleston）担任旁白。
pr:earthsounds.original: Immersive audio reveals the unexpected, unfamiliar and untold ways in which animals communicate around the world. Narrated by Tom Hiddleston.

pr:the-family-plan.text: 丹·摩根（马克·沃尔伯格饰）热爱他作为慈爱的丈夫、三个孩子的父亲和成功的汽车销售员的平静郊区生活。但这只是故事的一部分。几十年前，他曾是一名精英政府刺客，负责消灭世界上最致命的威胁。当过去的敌人追踪到他时，丹把毫无戒心的妻子（米歇尔·莫娜汉饰）、焦虑的十几岁女儿、职业玩家十几岁儿子和可爱的10个月大婴儿塞进他们的厢式旅行车，踏上了前往拉斯维加斯的即兴跨国公路旅行。为了保护家人，同时为他们提供一生难忘的假期，丹必须施展他长期沉寂的技能，同时又不能暴露他的真实身份。
pr:the-family-plan.original: Dan Morgan (Mark Wahlberg) loves his quiet suburban life as a devoted husband, father of three and successful car salesman. But that’s only half the story. Decades earlier, he was an elite government assassin tasked with eliminating the world’s deadliest threats. When enemies from his past track him down, Dan packs his unsuspecting wife (Michelle Monaghan), angsty teen daughter, pro-gamer teen son and adorable 10-month-old baby into their minivan and takes off on an impromptu cross-country road trip to Las Vegas. Determined to protect his family — while treating them to the vacation of a lifetime — Dan must put his long-dormant skills into action, without revealing his true identity.

pr:lovely-little-farm.text: “Lovely Little Farm”讲述了姐妹俩吉尔和杰姬在薰衣草田环绕的农场里关爱和抚养所有动物的故事。当一名年轻的农夫并不容易，但每一天都给这对姐妹带来冒险和成长的机会。这部真人与动画结合的作品采用了最新的电脑生成技术，并与工业光魔公司（Industrial Light and Magic）合作，将该剧集生动呈现。
pr:lovely-little-farm.original: “Lovely Little Farm” follows sisters Jill and Jacky as they love and nurture all the animals on their farm nestled in lavender fields. Being a young farmer isn’t easy, but every day brings these sisters adventure and a chance to grow. The live-action animated hybrid uses the latest computer-generated technology, working with Industrial Light and Magic, to bring the series to life.

pr:amber-brown.text: 改编自保拉·丹齐格（Paula Danziger）的畅销书系列（印刷量已超过 1000 万册），“Amber Brown”真实展现了一个女孩在父母离异后通过艺术和音乐寻找自我声音的过程。
pr:amber-brown.original: Based on the bestselling book series by Paula Danziger, with over 10 million copies in print, “Amber Brown” is an unfiltered look at a girl finding her voice through art and music in the wake of her parents’ divorce.

pr:911-inside-the-presidents-war-room.text: 通过布什总统及其最亲密的顾问的视角，体验2001年9月11日的事件，他们亲自详细讲述了那个历史性日子的关键时刻和重大决定。
pr:911-inside-the-presidents-war-room.original: Experience the events of September 11, 2001 through the eyes of President Bush and his closest advisors as they personally detail the crucial hours and key decisions from that historic day.

pr:wolfwalkers.text: 在充满迷信与魔法的时代，年轻的学徒猎人罗宾·古德菲洛与父亲一同前往爱尔兰，以消灭最后一群狼。在探索城墙外禁忌之地的过程中，罗宾结识了一位崇尚自由的女孩梅布，她属于一个神秘的部族，据说拥有在夜晚变身成狼的能力。在寻找梅布失踪的母亲时，罗宾揭开了一个秘密，这让她更深地陷入了狼行者的奇幻世界，并面临变成她父亲奉命消灭的同类的风险。
pr:wolfwalkers.original: In a time of superstition and magic, a young apprentice hunter, Robyn Goodfellowe, journeys to Ireland with her father to wipe out the last wolf pack. While exploring the forbidden lands outside the city walls, Robyn befriends a free-spirited girl, Mebh, a member of a mysterious tribe rumored to have the ability to transform into wolves by night. As they search for Mebh’s missing mother, Robyn uncovers a secret that draws her further into the enchanted world of the Wolfwalkers and risks turning into the very thing her father is tasked to destroy.

pr:greyhound.text: 汤姆·汉克斯饰演一位资深海军退伍军人，他作为首次担任船长的指挥官，在第二次世界大战期间负责保护一支由37艘船只组成的船队，护送数千名士兵和急需物资穿过危机四伏的大西洋海域。在长达五天没有空中掩护的时间里，船长和他由三艘护航舰组成的小型舰队必须穿过一片被称为“黑坑”的海域，在保护宝贵的船只和士兵的同时与纳粹U型潜艇作战。《灰猎犬号》的灵感来源于大西洋海战期间发生的事件，该海战发生在美利坚合众国与大国英国及盟军结盟的最早几个月。斯蒂芬·格拉汉姆、罗布·摩根和伊丽莎白·苏与汉克斯一同主演。《灰猎犬号》由汤姆·汉克斯编剧，亚伦·施奈德执导，加里·戈茨曼制片。《灰猎犬号》是索尼影视娱乐/第六阶段电影公司的Playtone制片厂作品，并联合了布龙创意公司、正夫影业、西卡莫尔影业和电影国度娱乐公司。
pr:greyhound.original: Tom Hanks stars as a longtime Navy veteran who, as a first-time captain, is tasked with protecting a convoy of 37 ships carrying thousands of soldiers and much-needed supplies across the treacherous waters of the Atlantic during World War II. For five days with no air cover, the captain and his small force of three escort ships must make their way through an area of the ocean known as “the Black Pit,” battling Nazi U-boats while protecting their invaluable ships and soldiers. “Greyhound" is inspired by events during the Battle of the Atlantic, which took place in the earliest months of America’s alliance with Great Britain and the Allied Forces. Stephen Graham, Rob Morgan and Elisabeth Shue star alongside Hanks. “Greyhound" was written by Tom Hanks, directed by Aaron Schneider and produced by Gary Goetzman. "Greyhound” is a Playtone Production from Sony Pictures Entertainment/Stage 6 Films, in association with Bron Creative, Zhengfu Pictures, Sycamore Pictures and FilmNation Entertainment.

umc.cmc.ns4q9hpoj4b1749wbl7crwbl.text: 《神奇宠物！》的主演豚鼠林尼、小鸭明明和乌龟塔克是教室里的宠物。每天最后一个孩子离开后，它们会接听来自世界某处陷入困境的幼小动物的易拉罐求救电话。它们会立刻飞奔或爬行，乘着由散落的玩具做成的飞船前往救援。主角们通过真实的儿童歌声进行交流。曾获奖的作曲家为每场历险的起伏以及探索区域的文化创作了相应的音乐伴奏。
umc.cmc.ns4q9hpoj4b1749wbl7crwbl.original: Stars of The Wonder Pets! Linny the guinea pig, Ming-Ming the duckling, and Tuck the turtle are classroom pets who, after the last child has left for the day, answer a tin-can call from a baby animal in distress somewhere in the world. They instantly fly, hop, or crawl into action by flying off to the rescue in their Flyboat (made from scattered playroom toys). The main characters communicate via song, using real children's voices. Award-winning composers have developed musical accompaniments that match the ups and downs of each adventure and the culture of the area explored.
